pages.text: Firelink is a sanctuary. Nothing hostile lingers here, and nothing here can be broken.$(br2)The $(l)Merchant$() and $(l)Blacksmith$() trade for souls. Every kill feeds your soul count. No refunds.

$(l)Choose your origin$(): right-click one of the six statues around the bonfire. Knight, Sorcerer, Pyromancer, Cleric, Thief or Deprived. One choice only.$(br2)Then take a $(l)burial gift$() from the pedestals in the chapel. Also one only.
The $(l)Inscription Table$() in the chapel binds spell scrolls into spellbooks.$(br2)Rest under the bonfire's roof when it rains: the rain wears on your sanity, the fire mends it.
